scenes.narration: Which makes Live Nation more profit, the concert, or the ticket?
In 2025, Live Nation put on 55 thousand shows for 159 million fans.
Concerts brought in 20.9 billion dollars. But the profit margin was just 3.3 percent.
Ticketing is the opposite, with a margin of about 37 percent.
So ticketing made 1.1 billion of adjusted profit, more than concerts' 0.7 billion. Sponsors added 0.8 billion.
Shows bring the crowd. Tickets bring the profit.
